name: ZeroDev
description: Modular smart account platform built on the Kernel smart account standard. Provides session keys, permissions plugins, and programmable transaction policies on top of ERC-4337. The preferred AA choice when session keys or advanced smart account programmability is needed beyond standard gas sponsorship.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Production-grade AA on Base. Preferred when session keys or per-action permission policies are needed in Base consumer apps.
Full Kernel smart account support on Ethereum mainnet. Core tool in the ethereum-aa-native-app workflow.
AA infrastructure can be used for gasless Farcaster miniapp actions, but Pimlico is typically sufficient without session key complexity.
ERC-4337 is EVM-only. ZeroDev does not apply to Solana.

common_pairings.context: ZeroDev provides the Kernel smart account with session key logic; Pimlico provides the bundler and paymaster infrastructure that submits ZeroDev UserOperations. Often used together in the same stack.
Privy creates the embedded wallet (EOA/signer); ZeroDev deploys a Kernel smart account on top of that signer, enabling session keys and programmable policies.
Dynamic manages the wallet/signer layer; ZeroDev adds smart account capabilities (session keys, batching, gas sponsorship) on top of that signer.
ZeroDev bundler reads nonce, simulates UserOperations, and submits to the mempool via Alchemy or Pimlico RPC endpoints.

trust_evidence.description: ZeroDev Kernel is one of the two dominant ERC-4337 smart account implementations alongside Safe. Session key support is production-proven across multiple consumer apps.
ZeroDev SDK v5 is actively maintained. The permissionless.js SDK (maintained by Pimlico) provides compatibility layer for Kernel accounts.
Comprehensive documentation for Kernel smart account, session keys, and permissions plugins.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use Pimlico directly for gas sponsorship at hackathon scale. ZeroDev session keys add complexity that isn't needed for demos.
scale_guidance.mvp: Add ZeroDev when session keys are a core UX requirement — pre-approved recurring transaction flows, delegated signing for AI agents, or per-action spending policies.
scale_guidance.production: Session key expiry policies are non-negotiable in production — infinite session keys are a security vulnerability. Set short TTLs and implement key rotation. Monitor bundler submission failures.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When only gas sponsorship is needed without session key or smart account plugin requirements. Pimlico is simpler for paymaster-only use cases and has stronger Base-specific integrations.
When already fully in the Alchemy ecosystem and prefer single-vendor infrastructure for RPC + AA without session key complexity.

anti_patterns: Using ZeroDev Kernel for simple gas sponsorship without session keys — Pimlico is simpler and sufficient for paymaster-only use cases.
Session keys without expiry policies — session keys that never expire are a permanent signing authority. Always set TTL and permission scopes.
Conflating ZeroDev (smart account + bundler) with Pimlico (bundler + paymaster only) — they serve overlapping but distinct roles; understand which layer you're replacing.
Deploying Kernel accounts without testing counterfactual address determinism — smart account address depends on the factory and salt; incorrect assumptions cause fund loss.

sdk_migration.notes: @zerodev/sdk v4 (last: 4.7.8, July 2024) is effectively abandoned with no formal npm deprecation. v5 (5.5.10) is the current version. Migration is high-effort: dependency model shifted from permissionless.js to viem native AA, function signatures changed extensively (sendTransaction rename, encodeCalls API, new client parameter). Phase 5.1 semver matching will enable CRITICAL detection for ^4 repos.
